macro_diagnostic.purpose: diagnostic, not the original acceptance CI rule

backend_sensitivity.interpretation: Stored GPU probability/labels are authoritative for this CUDA protocol; independent CPU softmax can cross a one-ULP threshold boundary.

model_file.reason: The result ZIP intentionally excludes model weights.
model_file.verification: Reports and prediction hashes agree; the actual GPU package bytes and original training checkpoint cannot be rehashed locally without those files.

limitations: 20 copied verification images do not audit all dataset image bytes or content duplicates.
Image bootstrap intervals do not capture uncertainty across generator families/datasets.
In-dist preprocessing changed from old stretch224 to canonical CLIP; differences cannot be attributed only to temperature.
Single-run L4 synthetic-input timings exclude I/O/preprocessing and do not generalize to other GPUs.
G7.2 point-threshold verdicts are retained; no significance or superiority is inferred from calibration improvements.

distribution_cautions.content_duplicate_verification: not possible from these prediction files; same names/logits are candidate shared references, not a byte/content proof
